title: 第一百零六章 向北
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

天，亮了。

没有日出。废墟之上的天空，是一种浑浊的、灰蒙蒙的铅色，像一块巨大的、浸饱了脏水的抹布，低低地压下来，让人喘不过气。

林秋和王虎醒了。

他们睡得很浅，稍微有点动静就会惊醒。醒来时，第一眼看到的是那堆已经熄灭的篝火，和蹲在旁边、像一尊金色雕塑的金尸。

身体依旧是干枯的，没有力气，也没有饥饿感。但心里那种空荡荡的、被掏空了的恐惧，似乎被昨晚那锅难吃的糊糊，稍微填满了那么一点点。

林秋走到金尸身边，学着它的样子，蹲下来，拨弄了一下那堆灰烬。几颗未燃尽的木炭，发出暗红色的光。

“陈默师兄……”她轻声开口，声音还是很哑，“我们要去哪？”

金尸没有回头。

它缓缓地站起身，那具沙砾构成的躯体，在灰蒙蒙的天光下，显得格外高大，也格外荒凉。

它抬起手，指向一个方向。

青云宗废墟的北方，是连绵起伏的、同样被战争波及的荒山。山势险恶，怪石嶙峋，看不到任何灵田、坊市、或者传送阵的影子。那是一片被文明遗弃的、充满死亡气息的蛮荒之地。

“北？”王虎走过来，皱着眉头，看着那个方向，“去北边干什么？那边什么都没有。灵气也稀薄得可怜，连妖兽都不愿意待。”

金尸没有解释。

它只是转过身，那双琥珀色的眼眸，扫过林秋和王虎。

目光平静，却带着一种不容置疑的决断。

然后，它迈开了脚步。

一步，踏出了这片废墟。

林秋和王虎对视了一眼。他们没有再多问，只是默默地，跟了上去。

离开，是唯一的选择。

这片曾经是他们家的地方，现在已经变成了坟墓。留在这里，只有死路一条。玄虽然死了，但玄带来的灾难，以及青云宗覆灭的消息，迟早会传开。到时候，觊觎金尸力量的，想要报仇的，甚至是像玄一样从遗迹里爬出来的其他怪物……都会蜂拥而至。

他们必须走。

金尸走在最前面。它的步伐很稳，每一步落下，都会在焦黑的土地上，留下一个清晰的、沙砾构成的脚印。但这些脚印，很快就会被风吹散，消失无踪，就像它从未存在过一样。

林秋和王虎跟在后面。他们的身体还很虚弱，走得很慢，时不时就要停下来喘口气。但他们没有抱怨，也没有停下。

一路上，死寂。

没有鸟叫，没有虫鸣，没有溪流的哗哗声。只有风，干燥而冰冷的风，裹挟着灰尘和焦糊味，刮过脸颊，像刀割一样疼。

他们路过一些小的村落和坊市。

那些地方，比青云宗更惨。

青云宗至少还有残垣断壁，而这些地方，已经彻底被抹平了。地上，到处都是干枯的、扭曲的尸体，有些保持着临死前奔跑的姿势，有些则相互纠缠在一起，分不清你我。

林秋别过头，不敢看。

王虎则死死地咬着牙，拳头捏得咯咯响。

金尸，依旧面无表情。

它只是走着。

路过那些尸体时，它会停下，用那双琥珀色的眼睛，看一眼。

然后，它会伸出手，从路边，捡起一些东西。

一块破碎的玉佩。

一只小孩的鞋子。

一把断掉的锄头。

它把这些东西，都收进怀里。

它的怀里，很快就鼓鼓囊囊的，装满了这些毫无用处的、沾满血污的“垃圾”。

林秋不知道它在做什么。

王虎也不知道。

但他们没有阻止。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It's dawn.

There is no sunrise.The sky above the ruins was a turbid, gray lead color, like a huge rag soaked in dirty water, pressing down low, making people breathless.

Lin Qiu and Wang Hu woke up.

They sleep very lightly and wake up at the slightest movement.When I woke up, the first thing I saw was the extinguished bonfire and the golden corpse squatting next to it, like a golden sculpture.

My body was still dry, I had no strength, and I felt no hunger.But the empty, hollowed-out fear in my heart seemed to be slightly filled with the unpalatable pot of mush last night.

Lin Qiu walked to the golden corpse, imitated its appearance, squatted down, and fiddled with the pile of ashes.A few unburned charcoal glowed dark red.

"Senior Brother Chen Mo..." She spoke softly, her voice still hoarse, "Where are we going?"

The golden corpse did not look back.

It stood up slowly. The body made of gravel looked particularly tall and desolate in the gray sky.

It raised its hand and pointed in one direction.

To the north of the Qingyun Sect's ruins are rolling barren mountains that were also affected by the war.The mountains are dangerous and rugged with strange rocks. There are no spiritual fields, squares, or teleportation arrays in sight.It was a barbaric land abandoned by civilization and full of death.

"North?" Wang Hu came over, frowned, and looked in that direction, "Why go to the north? There is nothing there. The spiritual energy is pitifully thin, and even monsters don't want to be there."

The golden corpse had no explanation.

It just turned around, its amber eyes scanning Lin Qiu and Wang Hu.

His eyes were calm, but with an unquestionable determination.

Then, it took steps.

One step out of this ruins.

Lin Qiu and Wang Hu looked at each other.They didn't ask any more questions and just followed him silently.

Leaving is the only option.

What was once their home has now become a tomb.Staying here will lead to death.Although Xuan is dead, the news of the disaster caused by Xuan and the destruction of Qingyun Sect will spread sooner or later.When the time comes, those who covet the power of the Golden Corpse, those who want revenge, and even other monsters like Xuan who crawled out of the ruins... will swarm over.

They must go.

The golden corpse walked in the front.Its steps were steady, and every step it took would leave a clear footprint made of gravel on the charred earth.But these footprints will soon be blown away by the wind and disappear without a trace, as if they never existed.

Lin Qiu and Wang Hu followed behind.Their bodies are still very weak and they walk very slowly, stopping to take a breath from time to time.But they didn't complain, and they didn't stop.

Along the way, it was dead silent.

There was no chirping of birds, no chirping of insects, no rushing of streams.There was only wind, dry and cold wind, carrying dust and a burnt smell, blowing across my cheeks, hurting like a knife.

They passed some small villages and markets.

Those places were even worse than Qingyun Sect.

Qingyun Sect at least still has ruins, and these places have been completely wiped out.On the ground, there were dry and twisted corpses everywhere, some maintaining the posture of running before death, while others were entangled with each other, making it impossible to distinguish between you and me.

Lin Qiu looked away, not daring to look.

Wang Hu gritted his teeth and clenched his fists loudly.

The golden corpse remained expressionless.

It just walks.

When passing by those corpses, it would stop and take a look with its amber eyes.

Then it reaches out and picks up something from the side of the road.

A broken jade pendant.

A child's shoe.

A broken hoe.

It takes all these things into its arms.

Its arms were soon bulging, filled with these useless, blood-stained "garbage".

Lin Qiu didn't know what it was doing.

Wang Hu didn't know either.

But they didn't stop.
